title: Close view of a 3D printer printing a gear-shaped part
visual_facts: A black and gray 3D printer frame fills most of the image.
A small nozzle is positioned just above a dark gray gear-shaped printed object on the build plate.
Horizontal metal guide rods and toothed belts run across the printer frame.
A clear enclosure panel and a built-in dark display panel are visible on the right.
spatial_relations: The printed gear rests on the build plate beneath the print head.
The brand lettering is on the lower right front panel.
uncertainties: The small brand text is visible but the exact printer model and print material are unclear.
